input_distribution.name: xiaoke_realistic_log_normal
input_distribution.recipe: w = LOG_DECAY_SCALE * sigmoid(z * W_BIAS_STD + W_BIAS_MEAN) with LOG_DECAY_SCALE=-0.6065306597126334, W_BIAS_MEAN=-2.80890, W_BIAS_STD=1.91028 (empirical mean/std of the Xiaoke-5-13B-2607 w_lora.lora.2.bias parameter, extracted via safetensors). r, k, v, kk, a, initial_state = torch.randn(shape) * INPUT_SCALE with INPUT_SCALE=0.1. All tensors allocated directly on the target NPU via torch.Generator(device=device).

w_documentation.expected_empirical_mean_w: approx -0.17 (matches real Xiaoke hidden state propagation)

timing_fence_contract: torch.npu.synchronize() before warmup; 20 warmup calls in a tight loop; torch.npu.synchronize() after warmup; independent initial state cloned outside the timed section; torch.npu.synchronize() before timed chain; 100 dependent calls in a tight loop (no sync, no copies, no item(), no logging inside); torch.npu.synchronize() after timed chain; elapsed = wall-clock delta; per_step_latency = elapsed / 100.

ascend.final_state: [B, H, D, V] (native layout already [B, H, D, V]; no transform outside timed region)

status_reason: Completed B in {1,2,8,16,32,64} x T in {1,128,512} across torch/triton/ascend with 3 reps each. T=1024 was excluded per the reduced-matrix request. Triton and AscendC backends used warmup=20, timed=100; torch used warmup=1, timed=1 (the torch reference is the slow Python-level recurrence and its latency is not the deliverable - precision parity is computed from a single torch call outside the timed loop).

torch_timing_deviation.reason: torch at T=512 B=64 takes ~21s/call (Python-level for-loop in fused_recurrent_rwkv7_ref). At timed=100 each measurement would take ~35 min x 3 reps = 1.75 h for ONE shape; the full T=512 torch pass would take many hours. timed=1 is used to keep the torch latency value, while the parity comparison (which is the actual deliverable for the precision table) is computed once outside the timed loop regardless. Triton and AscendC use the full warmup=20, timed=100 protocol.
